game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Vent Garden Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden, a garden growing near vents: the fire warden must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before smoke serpents spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden: a garden growing near vents
core_gameplay_loop: In Vent Garden, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before smoke serpents spring the trap. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the predictions value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the ash barrier using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The ash barrier reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the ash barrier is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mixed Type Oracle' (Week 2 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Vent Garden'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Vent Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ash barrier reached with actions_used <= 14.
